author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 이동기에 드물게 찾아옴, 지금까지 기록 10건 미만
summary: 이동기에 드물게 나타나는 새로, 지금까지 국내 기록이 10건이 안 되며 5월에 백령도와 대구의 공원 등에서 관찰되었다. 원래 중국 남부와 타이완, 인도차이나 북부에 사는 텃새로, 농경지와 물가, 마을 주변 같은 트인 저지대를 좋아하고 숲과 산지는 피한다. 무리를 지어 땅 위를 걸으며 곤충과 씨앗, 열매, 우렁이 같은 고둥 등을 가리지 않고 먹고, 나무 구멍이나 건물과 벼랑의 틈에 둥지를 튼다. 사람 말을 흉내 내는 새장 새로 오래 길러져 왔기 때문에, 원래 분포지 밖에서는 놓아 기르던 새가 퍼진 무리도 있다.

art.subject: Crested Myna (Acridotheres cristatellus), adult (sexes alike, plumage similar year-round): entire plumage black with a slight dull gloss; a short bushy tuft of feathers rising from the forehead above the bill base; a white patch at the base of the primaries, showing as a small white mark on the folded wing; undertail coverts black with narrow white tips; tail black with narrow white tips to the outer feathers; bill ivory to pale yellowish; iris pale orange-yellow; legs dull orange-yellow.
art.pose: walking on short grass, side view, forehead tuft visible
art.scene: open grassy farmland edge with scattered trees on a Korean offshore island in spring, bright daylight; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view walking on short grass: stocky starling-like bird, short erect tuft of feathers on the forehead above the bill, stout ivory bill, blackish plumage all over, small white mark at the base of the primaries on the folded wing, black undertail coverts with narrow white tips, short square black tail with white tips to the feathers

adult, in flight seen squarely from below: head, body and tail in one line, broad rounded wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, large white patch at the base of the primaries on each wing, blackish body, ivory bill, black undertail coverts with narrow white tips, short black tail with white tips, feet tucked under the body
art.build: A stocky, starling-like bird, a little larger than a White-cheeked Starling, with a short tail and strong legs. Head with a distinctive erect tuft on the forehead just above the bill. Bill stout and straight, slightly shorter than the head. Legs medium and sturdy, orange-yellow; walks with a strutting gait. Tail short and square. In flight the broad, rounded wings show a large white patch at the base of the primaries, conspicuous from above and below.
avoid: Do not paint bare yellow skin around the eye or a brown body; that is Common Myna (Acridotheres tristis).
Do not paint white undertail coverts; that is Javan Myna (Acridotheres javanicus).
Do not paint a long crest on the crown; it is a short tuft on the forehead.
Do not make the bill orange or black; it is ivory to pale yellow.
